title: Learning is empty when Maya is still loved
summary: This meets the person who keeps collecting religious words while staying attached to the same old cravings. The line exposes knowledge without inward turning.
takeaway: Do not let learning hide attachment.
lifeApplication: Before quoting, teaching, or correcting, check what the heart is still clinging to. Let one attachment be named before one more insight is performed.

source.shortMeaning: Religious learning stays hollow while attachment still rules the heart.
source.lifeApplication: Before teaching the line, ask what attachment in you still refuses it.

evidence.coreClaim: Religious learning stays hollow while attachment still rules the heart.
evidence.turn: Knowledge without inward freedom still serves attachment.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before quoting, teaching, or correcting, check what the heart is still clinging to. Let one attachment be named before one more insight is performed.
